text:
Alice K: FYI I got two pages in the last 10m about high tail latency on hosted API (p95 spike ~3s). PagerDuty routed to infra-oncall, but the traces point at runtime KV cache misses. Confused about routing — who should be primary for this class?
Ben R: :rotating_light: I saw the same PD alert. PagerDuty rule is infra -> runtime fallback, but looks like the tag that triggers runtime routing isn't set for this model group.
Incident Bot: [INC-2026-0314] New incident opened: hosted-api-high-latency. Severity: SEV2. Affected customers: multiple small clusters. Link: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-0314
Carla M: Quick triage: if p95 is spiking and traces show long kernel time + KV cache miss ratio rising, runtime should be primary. Infra handles network/GPU infra issues (node failures, network errors). Security only if we see auth/anomalous access.
Dave L: Agreed. We should update the PD routing rule to include model-tag:runtime-critical so future pages go to runtime-oncall first. For now, runtime-oncall can you take this? @Runtime Oncall
Runtime Oncall: Taking it. I'm attaching the ops runbook snippet I'm following:
```
Runbook: hosted-api-high-latency
1) Check autoscaling and GPU utilisation: /ops/metrics/gpu
2) Check runtime KV cache hit rate: metric/runtime/kv_hit
3) Look for model fallback logging: /logs/runtime/fallback
4) If cache miss > 20% and spike coincides with traffic change, consider warming with prefix-caching and enable temporary cache-lock.
```
Erin S: Noted coverage gap: nights 02:00-04:00 PST currently only have infra coverage (we rotated weekend). Runtime secondary is offshore but their PD window doesn't cover that slot. We need a short-term swap so runtime owns that window.
Alice K: Who's available to cover 02:00-04:00 PST this week? It's blocking our ability to hand off responsibilities. We should also publish a quick Runbook One-Pager to #eng-oncall pinned.
Ben R: I can stretch one night this week (Thu -> Fri). Will do the handoff with the offshore runtime team. I'll update the schedule in the oncall-calendar.
Carla M: Thanks Ben. Also — cross-team escalation note: if runtime identifies GPU OOM or node-level problems, they should page Infra and post brief root cause in the incident channel. If runtime suspects model poisoning or credential abuse, page Security immediately (use sec-oncall tag).
Support Oncall: Heads-up — we already have two customers DM'ing support. Please include customer-impact line in postmortem template (even preliminary): affected endpoints, % of requests affected, mitigation steps.
PagerDuty: Escalation used: infra-oncall -> runtime-oncall fallback. Manual rerouting added by Ben R at 1900012580 to include runtime tag for model-group alpha.
Dave L: For live mitigation: runtime, can you try enabling cache-lock and a temporary 10s prefix cache? If that doesn't move p95 within 10min, fallback to model-quantized variant (route by policy) to reduce compute pressure.
Runtime Oncall: Enabled cache-lock and warmed hot prefixes at 1900012640. p95 dropped from ~3.1s to ~1.4s in the next 6m. Monitoring for regressions. Added a note to the incident timeline.
Security Oncall: No suspicious auth patterns so far. If you see token reuse across accounts within short windows, page us.
Alice K: Thanks all. Action items: (1) Ben covers Thu->Fri 02:00-04:00 PST (update calendar) (2) Dave to update PD routing rule to include runtime tag (done @1900012580) (3) Runtime to publish quick howto for cache-lock (please post in #devex) (4) Support to collect affected customer list and churn risk.
Erin S: I'll create a short runbook one-pager and pin it to #eng-oncall. Also drafting a temporary PD rule until infra+runtime tagging is fixed.
Carla M: Leaving a note: handoff checklist quick template —
- Current active incidents
- Open pages in last 24h
- Coverage gaps (timezones)
- Runbooks to follow (links)
Please add to your handoff message when you go offline.
Alice K: Closing loop — runtime mitigation held, customer impact minimal, support following up. We'll keep the incident open for postmortem and update SEV2 channel after RCA. Thanks :heart:
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-0314 status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Owner: Runtime Oncall. Severity remains SEV2 until RCA.
